answer: Give every identity a provenance kernel: a signed chain of its past exchanges. Weight accrues only when that kernel's roots are diverse. Honest histories spread like water through karst, touching many independent counterparties, while a sybil cluster's exchanges all drain back into the same few sinkholes, however many identities it spins. Require each kernel to include one anchor exchange, hard as onyx to counterfeit: verified by a counterparty outside its own cluster and independently checkable. Clusters fail the diversity test on their own arithmetic, with no stake or confession needed.
